title: CryptoVerse
tagline: A reputation and ZKP authentication based Web3 Hub for Developers and Companies Alike.
description:
We are building a reputation-driven, ZKP authenticated Social Hub for Web3 developers a space where your passion for decentralized technologies is recognized and rewarded.

Our platform leverages zero knowledge proofs to ensure trust, privacy, and fairness while combating AirDrop farming through authentic engagement. Users can earn rewards not just for participation, but for meaningful contributions such as exploring our blogs, engaging with launches, and answering knowledge driven questions.

In short, we are creating a community first ecosystem where genuine curiosity, collaboration, and innovation in Web3 are what truly pay off.
how_its_made:
This project uses Self.xyz's identification for identifying unique users, and we use flow chain for hosting smart contracts, for its excellent support for game based web3 applications.
We use walrus for storage for its ease of use and client side encryption for sensitive files and nft metadata storage.
